hypotheses.justification: Split on whether p is prime. In the prime case, use the existing proof. Otherwise, Nat.ordCompl_of_not_prime gives ordCompl[p] m = m and ordCompl[p] n = n, while Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_prime makes both exponents zero. The conclusion reduces to gcd m n = gcd m n * 1. This also covers p = 0 and p = 1, since p ^ 0 = 1.
